title: DSMP Tweaks
description: Fixes for some mods and compatibility tweaks
body:
**This is a compatiblity mod for my modpack, Instalation outside the modpack may cause issues!**

This mod adds things like,
- Fixed the night vision on a helmet from survival insticts.
- Custom "pocketed" enchantment for the TinyInv mod.
- Ability for lockpick from chovy's apocalypse mod to unlock chests (because i have no idea what mod was locking some chests)

  And many other things to be added when issues arrive.
